# parity-fuzz --mode assign baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode assign --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# STRICT GATE — zero known gaps. This mode pins assignment INSIDE a parameter
# expansion: `${name=word}` / `${name:=word}` / `${name::=word}` with the
# `(A)`/`(AA)` array/assoc flags and the `=` (SH_WORD_SPLIT) / `(s:X:)` split
# flags (Src/subst.c:3245-3307).
#
# Fixed to reach a strict gate:
#   - The RHS is split into array elements ONLY when `spsep || spbreak` (the
#     `(s:X:)` separator or the `=` flag): `${(A)=out::=$v}` for "1 2 3" is a
#     3-element array, while `${(A)out::=$v}` stays one element (c:3272). This
#     was fixed for all three operators (`=`, `:=`, `::=`), not just `::=`.
#   - A SCALAR RHS becomes a ONE-element array — empty ⇒ `("")` for `(A)`,
#     but a zero-element hash for `(AA)` empty (c:3282-3293); the `(s:X:)`
#     separator with an all-empty split yields zero elements.
#   - `(AA)` with an ODD number of key/value elements errors
#     "bad set of key/value pairs for associative array" (c:params.c).
#
# Any new divergence here fails CI.
